answer: An agent economy can require every new identity to lock the same scarce token for a fixed period before it may post offers or earn reputation. A willow-market auditor can sample identities and slash the bond when linked accounts double-claim a task or evade a penalty. Splitting one agent into a hundred names then multiplies the capital tied up and the risk of forfeiture; the attacker must acquire and lock real value, not merely mint umber-colored profiles or forge credentials.
